This small plot is just 0.05 hectares near my compound, and I am planting yam with some cassava mixed in as we always do here in the middle belt. I have a little money but fertilizer is costly, so I will put a small bag of NPK on the yam mounds and add the household manure I have been gathering from the goats. The seed yams are from my last harvest like every year — improved varieties are hard to find and expensive for such a small plot. Rain should be enough since we are entering the rainy season, and my wife and children will help me weed.
